name: browser-use
headline: Roundtable - Unifies AI Coding Assistants
short_description: Roundtable is a zero-configuration MCP server that unifies multiple AI coding assistants like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini. It enables developers to use a standardized interface for AI-assisted coding, improving efficiency and consistency across projects. The server auto-discovers and integrates these tools, reducing setup time and complexity.
author: askbudi

sections.overview:
Roundtable AI is a local MCP server that lets you delegate tasks to specialized AI models simultaneously from a single prompt in your IDE. Instead of manually copying context between different AI tools, Roundtable packages shared project context and dispatches work to Gemini, Claude, Codex, and Cursor in parallel, with each model handling tasks suited to its strengths. The server automatically aggregates and synthesizes responses from all sub-agents, reducing wait time and eliminating context-switching errors. It uses your existing API subscriptions and CLI tools with zero markup, making it ideal for teams solving complex engineering problems that benefit from multiple specialized perspectives.
Multi-stack debugging: delegate frontend analysis to Gemini, backend to Codex, and infrastructure review to Claude simultaneously
Performance optimization: have specialized models analyze different system layers in parallel and synthesize findings
Code review workflows: leverage multiple models' reasoning strengths on the same codebase without manual switching
Complex feature implementation: distribute architecture planning, implementation, and testing across specialized models
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/askbudi/roundtable`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a Roundtable server to integrate [AI_TOOL_1], [AI_TOOL_2], and [AI_TOOL_3] for our development team. Configure it to prioritize responses from [PRIMARY_TOOL] but fall back to [SECONDARY_TOOL] if the primary is unavailable. Ensure the server is accessible via [ACCESS_METHOD] for all team members.
```
Copy

```
The Roundtable server has been successfully configured to integrate Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. The server is set to prioritize responses from Codex but will fall back to Claude Code if Codex is unavailable. The server is accessible via SSH for all team members. The server has auto-discovered the following AI coding assistants: Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. The server is now ready for use by the development team.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
